errors.evidence: The description omits the label/unit of the y-axis, which represents the number of countries ("брой страни"). It only describes the numerical scale from 0 to 80.

errors.text_span: Цветът на стълбовете постепенно изсветлява от 2012 към 2020 г., следвайки реда на легендата.
errors.evidence: The statement that the color of the bars gradually lightens from 2012 to 2020 is incorrect. The colors lighten from 2012 (dark blue) to 2016 (lightest blue/lavender) and then become darker for 2018 and 2020.
